doc: Defaults for GreyboxZone (M3-ARC-01; docs/kb/tech/chapter_flow.md): a zone layout file may override any of these per zone. Sizes in metres, angles in degrees, colours as #rrggbb.

encounters._note: M2-FP-28: FieldEncounters defaults a layout's encounters block may override. grace_m: metres walked after a random battle before the meter runs again. max_step_m: a frame's move longer than this is a placement, never walking. The Lead's FAST-TRACK (10-30, the human's playtest: fights too close together): every battle, scripted or random, owes the grace; grace_s: seconds of field time after it (counted from Rhen's first step back, while the story is free, so the fade back never counts); min_gap_m: the least gap any zone draws. At the 3.6 m/s run (field_movement.json) a zone's 95-145 m gap plus grace_m is a 31-44 s breather; tools/act1/encounter_pacing.py checks every zone.
